omit.autoplan/bin: Programs for the skill's Claude Code PreToolUse hook. Farero does not install skill hooks, and this package ships no programs.
omit.plan-ceo-review/bin: Programs for the skill's Claude Code PreToolUse hook. Farero does not install skill hooks, and this package ships no programs.
omit.design-review/templates/preview-fixtures: A JavaScript program that builds preview fixtures. This package ships no programs.

excluded.benchmark: Measures page performance through the browse daemon's perf and script commands. Farero's browser tools have no timing or script evaluation.
excluded.benchmark-models: Runs other agents' command lines (codex, claude, gemini) from the shell. Farero runs models only through its own providers and roles.
excluded.browse: The reference for gstack's browse daemon. It needs the compiled browse program and its long-running Chromium server.
excluded.canary: Saves baseline screenshots to files and compares them after a deploy. Farero's browser screenshots stay in the chat and cannot be saved for a later comparison.
excluded.captain: Runs a crew of agents through Capy's thread tools and gstack's train and digest programs, which Farero does not have.
excluded.careful: Works only through a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that runs a shell program. Farero does not install skill hooks, so the guard would not run.
excluded.codex: Wraps the codex command line from the shell. Farero runs Codex as a provider; the outside-voice role gives the same second opinion.
excluded.cso: Runs every audit through gstack-cso-launcher. Without it the skill stops with a tooling error by its own rule.
excluded.design-html: Builds finished pages with the vendored Pretext library and the compiled design program, which are programs this package does not ship.
excluded.design-motion: Captures and encodes motion through gstack's capture programs and ffmpeg.
excluded.diagram: Renders through gstack's offline diagram-render bundle and gstack-render, which this package does not ship.
excluded.eval-plan: Runs its budget ledger, dry run and pilot through gstack's eval programs and pricing library.
excluded.freeze: Works only through a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that runs a shell program. Farero does not install skill hooks, so the edit boundary would not hold.
excluded.gstack-upgrade: Upgrades a gstack install. Farero updates this package through the plugin directory.
excluded.guard: Turns on the careful and freeze hooks, which Farero does not install.
excluded.ios-clean: Needs Xcode, an iOS device or simulator and gstack's DebugBridge inside the app.
excluded.ios-design-review: Needs Xcode, an iOS device or simulator and gstack's DebugBridge inside the app.
excluded.ios-fix: Needs Xcode, an iOS device or simulator and gstack's DebugBridge inside the app.
excluded.ios-qa: Needs Xcode, an iOS device or simulator and gstack's DebugBridge inside the app.
excluded.ios-sync: Needs Xcode, an iOS device or simulator and gstack's DebugBridge inside the app.
excluded.landing-report: Reads the version queue only through gstack-next-version, which this package does not ship.
excluded.learn: Reads and writes learnings only through gstack's learnings programs, which this package does not ship.
excluded.make-pdf: Turns Markdown into a PDF with gstack's compiled make-pdf program, which this package does not ship.
excluded.open-gstack-browser: Starts gstack's own Chromium with its sidebar extension.
excluded.pair-agent: Shares the browse daemon with a remote agent over a tunnel.
excluded.plan-tune: Tunes gstack's question preferences, which only gstack's preamble programs and hooks read.
excluded.runaway-stopper: Needs Capy's thread and subagent tools, which Farero does not have.
excluded.scrape: Runs and saves browser skills through the browse daemon's skill runner.
excluded.setup-browser-cookies: Imports browser cookies into the browse daemon's session.
excluded.setup-gbrain: Sets up the gbrain command line and its database.
excluded.skillify: Writes browser skills for the browse client and runs them through the browse daemon.
excluded.sync-gbrain: Syncs code and memory into gbrain through its command line.
excluded.ubicloud: Needs the Ubicloud command line, an Ubicloud account and gstack's VM programs.
excluded.unfreeze: Clears the freeze hook's state. Farero does not install that hook.
excluded..github: Not a skill: gstack's CI workflows.
excluded..gstack: Not a skill: gstack's own ship and test policy files.
excluded.agents: Not a skill: an agent definition for another host.
excluded.agents-digest: Not a skill: a generated AGENTS.md digest for other hosts.
excluded.bin: Not a skill: gstack's shell, Bun and compiled programs. This package ships no programs.
excluded.browser-skills: Not a skill: saved browser-skill programs for the browse daemon.
excluded.capy: Not a skill folder: a gstack skill and installer for the Capy host.
excluded.claude-code: Not a skill: a template without a generated SKILL.md.
excluded.crew: Not a skill: programs and documents for gstack's crew controller.
excluded.design: Not a skill: the source of gstack's compiled design program.
excluded.docs: Not a skill: gstack's documentation. The pages that kept skills read are copied with files.
excluded.extension: Not a skill: gstack's Chrome extension.
excluded.gstack: Not a skill: llms.txt for gstack's website.
excluded.hosts: Not a skill: gstack's generator settings for each host.
excluded.lib: Not a skill: gstack's TypeScript libraries.
excluded.licenses: Not a skill: third-party license texts, copied with licenseFiles.
excluded.model-overlays: Not a skill: prompt overlays for each model. Farero role settings choose the models.
excluded.modules: Not a skill: gstack's install loadouts.
excluded.openclaw: Not a skill folder: skills and templates for the OpenClaw host.
excluded.patches: Not a skill: a dependency patch.
excluded.qm: Not a skill folder: gstack skills in the QM host's format.
excluded.scripts: Not a skill: gstack's build and generator scripts. scripts/jargon-list.json is copied with files.
excluded.supabase: Not a skill: gstack's telemetry backend settings. Left out with its endpoint and key.
excluded.test: Not a skill: gstack's tests and fixtures.
